description: Mobile phone service data from U.S. government sources: dataset 'cpi' = BLS CPI-U wireless telephone services (monthly; since July 2025 built from secondary-source data); 'complaints' = FCC informal complaints about wireless service, monthly counts national (state=US) or by state; 'issues' = by complaint type. FCC does not verify complaints; counts are not rates per subscriber and name no carriers. Free (no key or free key): the most recent 30 days of each series; a Pro key unlocks full history. Values are exact as published with unit, date and original source URL; incomplete days are flagged, never filled. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ending at the series' latest date. Older dates need a Pro key.

state.description: complaints only: two-letter code(s), US (default), or all

name: wireless_service
